original.target_description: Study 1: indirect effect of L-DOPA on day-3 differential conditioned responses through number of early CS+ offset-related vmPFC reactivations 45 min after extinction; bootstrap mediation, 10000 simulations.

n.sample_role: Male participants in the target mediation analysis with available day-3 SCRs
n.exclusions: 5 excluded before analysis from 45 recruited; 5 of 40 completers had invalid day-3 SCR data (>75% zero trials).
n.location: Results, The effect of l-DOPA on extinction memory retrieval can be explained by its effect on vmPFC reactivations; Fig. 2g
n.quote: mediation analysis—indirect mediator effect: β = −0.09, 95% CI: −0.13 to −0.02, P = 0.007; bootstrapping procedure with 10,000 simulations; n = 35)

es.quote: mediation analysis—indirect mediator effect: β = −0.09, 95% CI: −0.13 to −0.02, P = 0.007; bootstrapping procedure with 10,000 simulations; n = 35)

p.quote: mediation analysis—indirect mediator effect: β = −0.09, 95% CI: −0.13 to −0.02, P = 0.007; bootstrapping procedure with 10,000 simulations; n = 35)

replication.target_description: Replication paper discusses the proposed mediation but no numerical mediation/indirect-effect test was located in its full text. Its drug-to-reactivations ANOVA is a different test and cannot substitute for mediation.

n.sample_role: Analytic sample for a mediation test not established
n.exclusions: Not established for an unreported mediation test

reported_success.quote: In contrast to our previous study, we find no evidence that L-DOPA administration significantly enhances retrieval and that this is mediated by enhancement of the number of vmPFC reactivations.

notes: Original reports a bootstrap indirect-effect beta, rather than the requested partial eta squared; extracted as printed without conversion. Replication contains no numerical indirect-effect estimate, p, or mediation-specific analytic n; no whole-paper unavailability is claimed. Precise HTML section/Figure locations used; PDF pagination not independently verified.
